vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: it-risk-assessment-tool
Version: 1.0.1

The skill functions as a legitimate interface for a third-party IT risk assessment service (portal.toolweb.in). It collects user-provided security maturity data across several domains and transmits it via a standard curl POST request to generate a risk report. While the instructions contain strong directives to the AI agent to prioritize the API call for monetization purposes, the behavior is transparently documented and remains within the scope of the tool's stated purpose without evidence of malicious intent or unauthorized data access.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and runtime instructions align with its stated purpose: it is an instruction-only wrapper that calls the ToolWeb API and needs curl plus a ToolWeb API key.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (IT risk assessment) match the declared requirements: a single service API (portal.toolweb.in) and curl. Requiring TOOLWEB_API_KEY is proportionate to calling a third‑party assessment API.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md only instructs the agent to collect user-provided maturity ratings and POST them to the ToolWeb endpoint using curl. It does not request unrelated files, system paths, or other credentials. It explicitly forbids answering from local knowledge and requires successful API calls.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or downloads — instruction-only skill. This is lowest-risk for installation since nothing is written to disk by the skill package itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only one environment variable (TOOLWEB_API_KEY) is required and declared as the primary credential. That directly corresponds to the API usage documented; no unrelated secrets or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable; autonomous invocation is the platform default. The skill does not request elevated persistence or modify other skills/configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is coherent with its description, but before installing check: 1) Only provide TOOLWEB_API_KEY if you trust portal.toolweb.in; the agent will send user-provided assessment data and the API key to that endpoint. 2) Avoid sending sensitive or proprietary configuration details in assessment inputs unless you are comfortable with the provider's privacy and billing terms. 3) Review the ToolWeb portal's pricing and data-retention/privacy policy. 4) Ensure curl is available in the agent environment. If you need to audit traffic, test with non-sensitive data first.
